title: LivepatchDiff (livepatch-differential-harness)
description: Differential test harness for Linux livepatch build pipelines. Case study on Linux v6.6.47: ELF relocation triage, structural PLT32 bind checks (C3), loadable mutants, and per-case runtime predicates. Modules build from source against a pinned kernel; Docker stages separate module build from predicate replay. Cite SemVer tag v0.1.1.
